These layouts select the general-variable fitting path through cross-property references. Tests compute every fitted value from rule limits and a geometry feasibility callback, then reevaluate constraints and arrange the children; no native fitted value is supplied as an input. These controls do not cover specialized linear dimension fitting, text measurement, or automatic fitting-path classification. Factor controls independently bracket the strict absolute 1e-9 activity threshold at reference magnitudes 100 and 1000000; the raw factor is preserved in the native layout XML. Additional selector-alias rule controls use a 400x100 canvas and validate trial lookup through equivalent point-type spellings.
